title: Ashbury Rewards Programme Terms: Forfeiture of Free Night Awards
content:
These clauses of the Ashbury Rewards programme terms govern when Free Night Awards are lost.

**F1. First-night forfeiture.** An applied Free Night Award is forfeited only when it pays the first night of a reservation that was cancelled with a cancellation timing of after the deadline, where the award type's terms forfeit the award on a late cancellation, or that became a no-show, where the award type's terms forfeit the award on a no-show. Awards on later nights of that reservation are released instead.

The first night is the night of the reservation's arrival date; the award paying it is the award whose night is the arrival date. The cancellation timing, the status and the arrival date are read from the reservation record, and the night from the award record.

**F2. Top-off points.** Top-off points added to a forfeited award are lost with it.

**F3. Membership closure.** When the membership is closed and the award type's terms forfeit unused awards on closure, every award whose status is issued is forfeited. Awards already applied to a future reservation stay applied where the award type's terms keep applied awards through a closure.

**F4. Once only.** An award is forfeited at most once, and a forfeited award is never reissued.

## Outcomes under F1 (hypothetical three-night reservation with an award on each night, under terms that forfeit on a late cancellation and on a no-show)

| What happened | Award on the arrival night | Awards on the second and third nights |
|---|---|---|
| Cancelled, timing after the deadline | Forfeited | Released |
| Became a no-show | Forfeited | Released |
| Cancelled, timing before the deadline | Not forfeited | Not forfeited |

Because F1 forfeits an award only in the two cases it names, an award on a reservation cancelled before its deadline is not forfeited.
